lines.text: Why would you buy a new car when you could cold email every single car company and ask them for a free one?
lines.title: POV: you asked every car company for a FREE car 🚗😭

lines.text: I wanted to see if this would actually work, so I found every single car brand and asked for a free car.
lines.title: POV: you asked every car company for a FREE car 🚗😭

lines.text: In total, I found 567 emails, and I'm just so surprised that there were so many companies selling them.
Now, 113 of them gave me an auto-reply, and that was kind of annoying that it was all AI automated.
48 of them didn't even send, so I'm pretty sure it went straight to the spam.
And then 328 of them straight out ghosted me.
So at this point, I was starting to lose hope.
But I did end up getting 78 responses.
So now I'm gonna go to Hedwig and draft a convincing email response.
And in one click, Hedwig will draft a response for every single email for me.
Unfortunately, 51 of them said no, but 5 of them did send me a free sticker.
And I was pretty surprised that 22 of them actually said yes.
So I was pretty shocked with these results, and I'm not quite sure what they're going to send me, but I do not need 22 cars.
So, if you want a free one, follow me and comment below, and I'll give away one to any comment with zero likes.
